title: Optimize mobile UX: tap targets, sticky bottom category nav, faster visuals, one-column layout, and swipe interactions

requirements.text: Increase mobile touch target sizes across interactive controls (buttons, clickable cards, links) to be tap-friendly, ensuring primary actions on tool pages (e.g., upload area, primary CTA buttons, secondary/reset buttons) are comfortable to use on small screens.

quotes:
Optimize mobile user experience:

- Larger tap-friendly buttons

acceptanceCriteria: On screens <768px wide, primary and secondary buttons have a minimum comfortable tap area (no cramped text-only targets).
Clickable Card-based surfaces used as buttons (e.g., tool/category cards) have sufficient padding and a clear focus-visible ring for keyboard accessibility.
Tool pages (e.g., Image Compressor, PDF to Word) remain visually balanced after touch-target changes with no overflow/clipping.

requirements.text: Add a sticky bottom navigation on mobile that provides quick access to tool categories (e.g., PDF Tools, Image Tools, Calculators, Utility Tools). The bottom nav must be visible only on small screens, must not cover important CTAs, and must include an accessible interaction model (focus states, labels).

quotes: - Sticky bottom navigation for tool categories

acceptanceCriteria: On small screens, a bottom navigation bar is fixed/sticky and remains available while scrolling.
The nav includes the main tool categories with icons and English labels.
The nav does not block key page actions (e.g., primary CTA buttons); content has adequate bottom padding when the nav is present.
All nav items are keyboard-focusable with visible focus styling and have accessible names.

requirements.text: Optimize mobile performance for images and icons by reducing unnecessary work during initial render and ensuring media loads efficiently (e.g., lazy-loading non-critical images, minimizing heavy visual effects on mobile, and respecting prefers-reduced-motion).
acceptanceCriteria: Non-critical images in page content use lazy-loading where applicable, and above-the-fold visuals remain fast.
Mobile initial render avoids expensive effects where possible (or degrades them) without breaking layout.
Animations and transitions respect prefers-reduced-motion (reduced motion results in no/less animation).

requirements.text: Ensure a clean one-column layout on small screens for key content sections (home tool surfaces and tool pages), preventing multi-column grids from feeling cramped and ensuring readable spacing/typography on mobile.

quotes: - One-column clean layout on small screens

acceptanceCriteria: On screens <640px, major grid sections render in a single-column layout with consistent vertical spacing.
Text remains readable without horizontal scrolling; no card content overflows its container on mobile.
Tool landing pages and tool interfaces remain centered and usable on mobile, with no side-by-side layouts that cause crowding.

requirements.text: Add smooth swipe-friendly interactions/animations on mobile for browsing tool/category content (e.g., horizontal swipeable rows or carousels with scroll-snap), while keeping motion subtle and performant.
acceptanceCriteria: On small screens, at least one key tool discovery surface (featured tools and/or categories) supports horizontal swipe browsing with smooth scrolling and snap behavior.
Swipe behavior works with touch and trackpad, and does not interfere with vertical page scrolling.
Motion is subtle and disabled/reduced when prefers-reduced-motion is enabled.

constraints: Frontend immutable paths must not be edited: frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts, frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.tsx, frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx, frontend/src/components/ui (compose existing UI components instead).
Backend must remain single-actor (no additional backend services).
nonGoals: Do not add new tool functionality or backend processing logic (this request is mobile UX/performance only).
Do not introduce third-party services (CDNs, external image optimization services, analytics, etc.).

goalsToAdd: Improve mobile speed and usability across the app UI
preferencesToAdd: Use English for all user-facing text
